info.name: Notes Tracker API
info.description:
Every scenario for the Notes Tracker API. Start the backend (`npm run dev` in backend/), then run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner or Newman.

Folders clean up after themselves. Set `baseUrl` if the API is not on http://localhost:5000/api, and `frontendOrigin` to match `CORS_ORIGIN`.

item.description: Run in order: creates notes, lists, reads, updates in every supported way, deletes, and cleans up after itself.
